instruction.name: xvftinth.l.s
instruction.description: Convert single-precision floating point elements in higher part of every 128-bit vector of `a` to signed 64-bit integer, using current rounding mode specified in `fscr`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 5.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvftinth.l.s $xr0, $xr8; xvftinth.l.s $xr1, $xr9; xvftinth.l.s $xr2, $xr10; xvftinth.l.s $xr3, $xr11; xvftinth.l.s $xr4, $xr12; xvftinth.l.s $xr5, $xr13; xvftinth.l.s $xr6, $xr14; xvftinth.l.s $xr7, $xr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvftinth.l.s $xr0, $xr8; xvftinth.l.s $xr1, $xr9; xvftinth.l.s $xr2, $xr10; xvftinth.l.s $xr3, $xr11; xvftinth.l.s $xr4, $xr12; xvftinth.l.s $xr5, $xr13; xvftinth.l.s $xr6, $xr14; xvftinth.l.s $xr7, $xr15'

notes: Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
